scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Despite the customer stating she was shaking and terrified at [00:11] after a fraudulent £1,200 order was placed on her account, the agent remained purely clinical and never once offered empathy, reassurance, or an apology for her distress.

scorecard.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
scorecard.coaching: As stated at [14:47] and [17:02], cancelling the credit agreement, removing the £30 pending bill charge, and expunging the Equifax/Experian hard search require 48 hours from the back-office Fraud Operations team, and the customer could not test her new My S-Net login before the call ended.

grader.scenario: Suspected account takeover after clicking a fake parcel-delivery text; locking fraudulent handset upgrade order and resetting credentials
grader.notes: Good technical security call with 2 FAILs (E, RE) and 9 PASSes. Customer Devika is terrified ([00:11], -48.0 sentiment) after clicking a phishing parcel SMS that led to an unauthorized iPhone 16 Pro Max upgrade order and a queued eSIM swap. Agent Natasha verifies address, PIN, and security question immediately ([00:34]), paraphrases ([01:50]), conducts thorough forensic probing ([03:03]–[05:06]), and uses a properly managed 62s hold ([08:29]–[10:00]) to intercept the DPD warehouse shipment, abort the eSIM swap, and purge the attacker's session (O, H, PR PASS). However, Natasha is strictly clinical and never offers a single word of empathy, apology, or emotional reassurance for Devika's distress (E FAIL), and full resolution awaits the 48-hour Fraud Operations credit-agreement discharge and a 15-minute login cooldown ([14:47]–[17:02], RE FAIL).

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: [00:00] Agent: 'Good morning, thank you for calling S-Net Account Security and Support.' and [19:08] Agent: 'Thank you for choosing S-Net, Devika.'

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: [08:29] Agent: 'May I place you on a brief hold for about one minute while I call the warehouse dispatch controller...' -> [10:00] Agent: 'Thank you for holding, Devika.' (62s managed hold).

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: [00:34] Agent immediately requests address, four-digit security PIN, and security question; [00:52] Customer verifies 14 Vicarage Lane Guildford, PIN 5508, and 'Bluebell'.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: [00:34] Agent uses the customer's name 'Devika' consistently throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [00:11] Customer: '...I am shaking right now! Twenty minutes ago I got an email saying an order for a twelve-hundred-pound iPhone 16 Pro Max was placed on my S-Net account...' -> [00:34] Agent responds strictly procedurally and never expresses empathy or reassurance across the entire call.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: [01:50] Agent clearly restates the phishing link click, the unauthorized address change to Ilford, and the fraudulent iPhone 16 Pro Max upgrade order, and confirms accuracy.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent tracks every detail Devika provides (08:14 SMS timestamp, Ilford address, Monzo card freeze, mortgage application) without asking her to repeat anything.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [10:00] Agent personally intercepts warehouse order ORD-9920418, aborts pending eSIM swap ESIM-88310, revokes East London OAuth tokens, deletes the rogue ProtonMail email, updates the PIN, and raises Fraud Operations dossier FRD-2026-88412.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent is calm, composed, polite, and methodical throughout the high-urgency security call.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: [03:03]–[05:06] Agent conducts structured forensic probing into the phishing link timestamp, OTP entry, email password reuse, live cellular signal (SIM swap check), and bank card exposure.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: [14:47] Agent explains Fraud Operations takes up to 48 hours to void credit agreement CCA-771039 and remove the £30 charge; [17:02] Customer cannot log in to verify her new password for another 15 minutes.
